title: Puerto Rico Case Resolution Card
doc_notes: This document is an AARO case resolution card regarding a 2013 UAP sighting in Puerto Rico, concluding the objects were likely sky lanterns.

incidents.summary: CBP aircraft captured thermal video of two objects drifting at wind speed near Rafael Hernandez Airport, Puerto Rico.
incidents.explanation: AARO assesses with moderate confidence that the objects were a pair of sky lanterns.
incidents.location_name: Rafael Hernandez Airport, Aguadilla, Puerto Rico
incidents.quote: captured thermal video footage of two objects drifting at wind speed and direction.
